papers_read.title_as_printed: Predicting Mild Cognitive Impairment in Type 2 Diabetes: A Machine Learning Approach (Li et al., Journal of Diabetes Research 2025, Article ID 7304414)

Prediction and validation of mild cognitive impairment in occupational dust exposure population based on machine learning (Cai et al., Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety 2024;285:117111) - the same paper as P-19; the P-20 and P-19 extracts are byte-identical

what_each_reports.P-343: SVC on seven routine variables for clinically diagnosed MCI (AAN 2018 criteria, Beijing MoCA < 26) in 2074 T2DM inpatients: internal cross-validated AUC 0.74 +/- 0.04 (extract prints '0 74 ± 0 04', decimal points dropped; decoded from the paper's tables); external DECODE-cohort AUC 0.80.
what_each_reports.P-20: Same paper as P-19: XGBoost for MoCA-screened MCI (MoCA <= 26) in 1938 dust-exposed coal miners; training AUC 0.959, internal validation AUC 0.795, additional 351-miner test set AUC 0.913.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC of a routine-clinical-variable SVC for clinically diagnosed MCI vs normal cognition in hospitalised Chinese T2DM patients (quoted 0.80 = external DECODE figure; internal 0.74).
quantity_b: ROC-AUC of an XGBoost model on occupational, psychological and demographic variables for MoCA-screened MCI in working-age dust-exposed coal miners (quoted 0.913 = additional test set; internal validation 0.795).
incompatible_if_same: No. P-20's internal validation AUC (0.795) equals P-343's external AUC (0.80) to two decimals; the recorded gap arises only from pairing unlike splits, and neither paper claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match in the broad sense (cross-sectional MCI detection, T1).
gates.dataset_family: mismatch: Nanjing T2DM inpatient cohort vs a Huainan coal-mine occupational cohort; the record says dataset_equal 'No'; no waiver on record.
gates.validation_tier: match at the tier level (each reports a held-out cohort beyond the internal split); the registry codes P-20 as V4 and P-19 as V3 for the same paper.
gates.modality_family: match in family (clinical/tabular); predictor sets disjoint apart from age and education.

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC-AUC) but different populations behind the MCI label, different MCI definitions (clinical AAN criteria vs MoCA screen) and different predictor sets.
performance_validity: flag does not apply: compared figures 0.80 and 0.913, both below 0.97.
independence: P-20 is a duplicate of P-19 (identical extract; summaries.md Paper 19 = '1-s2.0-S0147651324011874-main (1).pdf', Paper 20 = '1-s2.0-S0147651324011874-main.pdf'). This record is the same comparison as C-184 and should be counted once.
grounds: P-20 is the same paper as P-19, so this record repeats C-184 and carries the same verdict.
The populations differ (older T2DM inpatients vs working-age coal miners), and so do the MCI definitions (AAN 2018 clinical criteria vs MoCA <= 26 screen).
The predictor sets differ apart from age and education; the dataset-family gate fails with no waiver on record.
Like-for-like splits agree: P-20's internal validation AUC 0.795 against P-343's external AUC 0.80.

evidence_quotes.quote: External validation with the DECODE cohort yielded an AUC of 0.80, an F1 score of 0.80, and a recall of 0.89.

This cross-sectional study prospectively enrolled adult inpatients diagnosed with T2DM from the Department of Endocrinology at Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital over the period from January 2016 to December 2023.

XGBoost (training set: AUC=0.959, validation set: AUC=0.795) and Logistic Regression (training set: AUC=0.818, validation set: AUC=0.816) models exhibited superior predictive performance. Results from the test set showed that the AUC of the XGBoost model (AUC=0.913) outperformed the Logistic Regression model (AUC=0.778).
A total score of ≤26 is considered to indicate that there may be mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and a total score of > 26 is defined as a normal population.

record_defects: The record treats P-20 as a distinct study from P-19 (C-184); they are the same paper, so the comparison is double-counted.
resolution 'Rejected: Task, dataset, or modality mismatch' contradicts resolution_note 'Confirmed genuine'.
resolution_status partially_resolved_candidate is not supported by any named third study showing a separating condition.
claim_a (0.80) is P-343's external figure, internal 0.74 omitted; claim_b (0.913) is P-20's additional test-set figure, internal validation 0.795 omitted.
Registry codes the same paper differently: P-19 Task T2 / Validation V3, P-20 Task T1 / Validation V4.
what_would_change_the_verdict: Nothing short of both models being evaluated on one population with one MCI definition; the duplicate status of P-20 does not change with further reading.
